content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** Harel has loads of stuff. I only saw one slice of it: the page opened on "קופת גמל להשקעה", which has 16 tracks. Every fee there looks about the same, "0.54%" to "0.61%" "מהחיסכון" and "0% מההפקדה", so the fee doesn't help me choose. What jumped out was "מניות" at "24.04%" over 3 years and "14.64%" over 5. "עוקב מדד S&P 500" was "13.7%" and "11.92%". If it were up to me now I'd go for מניות, or the S&P one because that's the one my friends talk about. I'm only medium sure. I didn't see my own קרן השתלמות or my pension, and I didn't see how many shekels a year those fees come to.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page.** Big "הראל" heading, then the "כל המוצרים של הראל" tabs: תגמולים ופיצויים 16, קרן השתלמות 16, קופת גמל להשקעה 16, קרן פנסיה מקיפה 19, קרן פנסיה כללית 18, חיסכון לכל ילד 4.
  - The green tab that was already open was "קופת גמל להשקעה". That one sounds like a pension thing for older people.
  - I wanted my השתלמות, but the screens only showed this one tab.
- **The second row of buttons.** Track types like "S&P 500", "מניות", "כללי". I didn't touch them.
- **The table.** I went down the track names and read only the big percentages.
  - Fees are all "0.5-something%", which sounds like nothing.
  - Half the return boxes say "פחות מ־3 שנים", with no number. So for most tracks there's nothing to compare, including the big ones like "עוקב מדדי מניות" (305 million).
  - The ring charts with "מניות" / "מט"ח" percentages I glanced at. I guessed the yellow dot means מט"ח, but I'm not sure what it means for me.
  - I mostly missed the "כסף מנוהל" column on the far left.
- **Bottom of screen 2.** The folded sections "קרנות מחקות 5", "מרכזית לפיצויים 7" and "קרנות סל 4" I didn't open. I can't tell קרן מחקה and קרן סל apart anyway.
  - "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" and the small grey lines under the table ("התקרה בחוק", "PF-10") I skipped.

**Words I didn't get:** "מט"ח", "ההפקדה" vs "מהחיסכון" (two different fees?), "תגמולים ופיצויים", "מרכזית לפיצויים", "לפני דמי ניהול", "PF-10".

**What bothered me:**
- To see "everything Harel offers" I'd have to click through 6 tabs of 16 to 19 tracks each, plus the folds. That's around 100 options. I'd have closed it somewhere around the table and decided to do nothing today.
- Most tracks have no return number.
- The fee is only a percent. Nowhere does it say how much it costs me in shekels.
